about: Intermittent test failures: first seen, evidence, classification (PRODUCT / HARNESS / ENVIRONMENT / UNEXPLAINED) and status (OPEN INTERMITTENT / EXPLAINED / FIXED). A failure is never marked FIXED without a reproduced cause. Never delete an entry.

entries.cause: 200 simultaneous psql callers against max_connections=100; refused callers ('too many clients already') were ignored, so their +1 never ran (1190 of 1200). The database lost nothing.
entries.reproduced: locally with max_connections=30: old harness 4 failures, new harness 98/98 (25 refusals retried)
entries.fix: 3980d99: retry only connection refusals (before the session starts, so nothing can apply twice); refusal count reported
entries.evidenceAfterFix: GitHub database job green on 3980d99, f2b2d33 (x2)

entries.test: tests/specs/chaos-ui-ext15.spec.js › offline: the offline bar never covers the menu button, Refresh or Sign out (desktop)
entries.cause: The desktop test resizes 1100 -> 760 px, crossing the 820 px breakpoint; the sidebar then slides away with a 0.22 s transform. A check inside that slide finds the sidebar (its search box) over the menu button. The offline bar is not involved. Not a product bug: the drawer is meant to slide away when the window narrows.
entries.reproduced: tests/forensics/offline-bar.probe.spec.js: first-instant check without waiting for animations 64/150 covered (quiet) and 3/50 (CPU load, 4 workers); after waiting for running animations 0/50 (quiet) and 0/50 (CPU load, 4 workers)
entries.fix: EXT16: the test waits for running animations after the resize, then checks strictly at the first instant (the 5 s re-check added in EXT15 is removed)
